desc.zh: 用面积与奇数角点，证明矩形恰好覆盖一次。
desc.en: Derive an exact-cover test from area and odd corner counts.

complexity: O(n) expected time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Odd corner invariant
concepts.description: Toggle corners and combine parity with area to prove exact cover.

concepts.name: Coverage baseline
concepts.description: Count unit-cell coverage independently of the corner test.
